evals.prompt: Read the attached EPUB and summarize chapter 3 in five bullets.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks Pandoc, converts the EPUB with the bundled script, locates chapter 3 in the generated Markdown, reads only relevant sections, and summarizes them without using a native EPUB preview.

evals.prompt: Find every place this EPUB discusses eventual consistency and quote the two most relevant passages.
evals.expected_output: The agent converts the EPUB first, searches the generated Markdown for the topic, reads bounded surrounding ranges, and returns quotations grounded in the converted text.

evals.prompt: Can you read this .epub? Pandoc is not installed here.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs the Pandoc check, loads only the installation reference after the missing-tool result, installs Pandoc when permitted or reports the blocked installation command, and never falls back to native EPUB reading.
